sources.ref: NTA, JEE (Main) 2026 Session 2, B.E./B.Tech question paper 'B Tech 2nd Apr 2026 Shift 1' (English)

notes: Figures of ingested previous-year questions, to be recreated as diagrams through visual-director (never scanned). Each brief describes the official figure; labels are placed at anchors once an image exists.

requests.brief: three panels side by side on white. Left panel: a circuit with an AC source on the left; across the two rails, a vertical branch holding an ordinary diode pointing down in series with a Zener diode pointing up; on the right, a tall empty rectangular box connected between a top terminal and a bottom terminal. Middle panel: axes with one full cycle of a sine wave, peak level marked by a dotted line and trough level by a dashed line, two tick marks on the time axis. Right panel: axes with a flat-topped positive pulse during the first half cycle and a flat-bottomed negative pulse of equal size during the second half cycle, two tick marks on the time axis. Recreate the figure of NTA's JEE (Main) 2026 paper, 2 April Shift 1, question 37 faithfully (same parts, positions and directions); every letter, number, sign and arrow label is added by the app at label anchors.
must_show: diode pointing down in series with a Zener diode pointing up across the rails
empty box between the top and bottom terminals
flat-topped positive and flat-bottomed negative output of equal size
must_not_show: a scan or copy of the original paper

alt.en: Part A: an AC source across an ideal diode in series with a 5 V Zener diode, with the unknown block between X and Y across the output. Part B: input sine wave of peak 20 V over 2 minutes. Part C: output clipped to +5 V in the first minute and to -5 V in the second.
alt.hi: भाग A: एक AC स्रोत, जिसके सिरों पर एक आदर्श डायोड और 5 V ज़ेनर डायोड श्रेणी में हैं, तथा निर्गत के सिरों पर X और Y के बीच अज्ञात खंड है। भाग B: 2 मिनट में शिखर 20 V की निवेशी ज्या तरंग। भाग C: निर्गत पहले मिनट में +5 V पर और दूसरे में -5 V पर कटा हुआ।
